how.title: How it works
how.sub: From the first click to the payout: everything happens on 9rayti, with a clear rule at every step.

search.d: Filter by price, rating, availability and lesson language. Each card shows hours taught and response rate.
search.r: Tutors who reply fast and are well rated come first.

request.d: Pick a free slot, attach your course or an exercise, and pay with credits or by card.
request.r: A 3 DT booking fee, shown before you pay.

wait.d: Follow your request live and get notified as soon as it's accepted. Until then, you can cancel.
wait.r: Declined or no answer: refunded in credits, automatically.

live.d: The room opens at lesson time: built-in video, documents, and messaging where contact details are hidden.
live.r: Once accepted, the lesson can't be cancelled, except by the tutor.

replay.d: The tutor uploads materials and a summary to your room. You'll find them the night before the exam.
replay.r: Everything stays in your space, even months later.

review.d: Your review helps other students. A problem? You have 24 h to report it.
review.r: The tutor is only paid after those 24 h: your money is protected.

signup.d: School, year and last year's average: the team checks once, then you choose your subjects.

agenda.d: One price per subject, free slots whenever suits you. You can also publish group exam sessions.
agenda.r: You keep 100% of your private lesson price.

accept.d: You see the subject, the time and the attached course. You have 12 h to reply.
accept.r: Declining often or letting requests expire lowers your ranking.

teach.d: In the 9rayti room: video, documents to share, and a summary to leave for the student.
teach.r: Stay on 9rayti: that's what guarantees your payment.

paid.d: Without a report, the payment goes out automatically. Track your earnings week by week.
paid.r: Group sessions: you get 80% of the seats sold.

money.a: You're refunded immediately in 9rayti credits, usable for another lesson. A cash refund is still possible as a last resort by writing to support.

absent.q: What if the tutor doesn't show up?
absent.a: Report it within 24 h after the lesson. The payout is blocked, the team checks, and you're refunded if the lesson didn't happen.

contact.q: Why is my number hidden in messages?
contact.a: So that everything happens on 9rayti: that's how we can protect and refund you. Phone numbers, emails, links and social network names are replaced with "•••".

verify.a: The team checks the school, year and last year's average on the transcript, once. The transcript isn't kept: only the "verified" badge remains.

price.q: How much does a lesson cost?
price.a: Each tutor sets a price per subject, often between 15 and 30 DT an hour. A 3 DT booking fee is added, shown before you pay.

lang.a: French, Arabic or English, depending on the tutor: their card shows the languages they speak, and you can filter the search.

how.ctaD: Find a tutor in two minutes, or offer your own lessons.

who.a: Any student at a Tunisian school or university who passed the subject they want to teach, with a good average last year.

verify.a: You send your transcript; the team checks your school, year and average, then approves your profile. The transcript isn't kept.

fee.a: Nothing on your private lessons: the student pays a 3 DT booking fee. On group exam sessions, 9rayti keeps 20%.

cancel.q: What if I have to cancel a lesson?
cancel.a: You can cancel an accepted lesson: the student is refunded in credits. Cancelling often lowers your ranking.

tax.a: The payment goes out 24 h after each completed lesson, with no report. Track every payout in the Earnings tab.

about.title: About
about.lead: 9rayti ("my studies" in Tunisian Arabic) connects students stuck on a subject with those who already passed it, across every school in the country.
about.mission1: Private lessons are expensive, and Facebook groups guarantee nothing: not the tutor's level, not a refund if the lesson doesn't happen.
about.mission2: 9rayti brings what was missing: verified tutors, protected payments, and a classroom where everything stays until the exam.

help.d: A SUP'COM student can help an ESPRIT student: knowledge flows between every school.

trust.d: Verified tutors, real reviews, money protected until the lesson: nobody takes a risk.

clear.d: Prices shown, fees announced, rules written down: 12 h to reply, 24 h to report.

row.refund: Refunded if the lesson doesn't happen

t1.d: Student-to-student tutoring, booking fees and exam sessions; the platform is the classroom.

t2.d: Student survey, sitemap, mockups, the "Sidi Bou Saïd" brand.

t3.d: Angular, NestJS and PostgreSQL: search, booking, classroom, three languages.

t4.d: Protected messaging, live notifications, full admin, animations and performance.

cgu.title: Terms of use
cgu.sub: Short, clear rules, the same for everyone. By creating an account, you accept them.

objet.d: 9rayti connects students ("students") with students who teach ("tutors") for online lessons. These terms govern the use of the site and its services.

comptes.d: An account belongs to one person and one role: student, tutor or administrator. Sign-up information must be accurate. You're responsible for keeping your password confidential.

role.d: 9rayti provides search, booking, payment, the classroom and messaging. Lesson content is the tutor's responsibility. Tutors are verified once (school, year, average) before appearing in search.

reservation.d: The student pays when sending a request, in 9rayti credits or by card. The tutor sets the lesson price; a 3 DT booking fee is added, shown before payment. 9rayti holds the money until the payout.

reponse.d: The tutor has 12 h to accept or decline a request. Without an answer, the request expires automatically. The tutor's response rate is shown on their profile and affects their ranking.

annulation.d: The student can cancel for free while the request is pending. Once accepted, only the tutor can cancel the lesson; the student is then refunded.

remboursement.d: If a request is declined, expires, is cancelled by the tutor or the lesson doesn't happen, the student is refunded in 9rayti credits. A cash refund remains possible as a last resort, on request to support.

versement.d: The payment goes to the tutor 24 h after the end of the lesson, if no report was made. Tutors keep 100% of their private lesson price.

signalement.d: The student has 24 h after the lesson to report a problem. The payout is then suspended; the team reviews the case and decides to refund the student or pay the tutor. The decision is explained and visible to both.

sessions.d: A tutor can offer a group session with a minimum number of students. If the minimum isn't reached before it starts, the session is cancelled and everyone is refunded. 9rayti keeps 20% of the seat price.

messages.d: Messaging is for preparing and following up lessons. To protect everyone, phone numbers, email addresses, links and social network names are hidden automatically. A tutor can't message a student first.

conduite.d: Respect, kindness and honesty are expected from everyone. Doing a graded assignment or exam on a student's behalf, harassment, or moving exchanges off the platform is forbidden. A breach may lead to account suspension.

donnees.d: In line with Tunisia's Organic Law No. 2004-63 on personal data protection, 9rayti only collects the data the service needs. Tutors' transcripts are never kept. You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data from the Contact page.

contenus.d: Materials shared in the room (PDFs, replay) remain their author's property. They're for the student's personal use and may not be resold or published.

modif.d: These terms may change. For any significant change, users are notified before it takes effect.
